about: Shared VD (vault descriptor pinning) vectors. Generated by vd-vectors-gen.ts from the real relay-enterprise code (vaultService.submitXpub verified every attestation; vaultDescriptorService built the descriptor/hash; vaultAddressService derived the addresses). Every wallet/Key implementation of canonicalJson, the hash, verifyVaultDescriptor and deriveVaultAddress must reproduce these exactly.

endpoint.auth: enterprise session (same as every vault read): org member (any role) with vault access (owner/admin: all vaults; member/viewer: active vault membership); vault must belong to the org
endpoint.success: HTTP 200 { status: "success", data: { success: true, descriptor, descriptorHash } }
endpoint.notReady: HTTP 409 { status: "error", data: { code: 409, name: "DESCRIPTOR_NOT_READY", message } } while the vault is pending_setup / any signer has not submitted xpubs
endpoint.otherErrors: HTTP 200 { status: "success", data: { success: false, error, errorCode } } like other vault reads (UNAUTHORIZED, NOT_MEMBER, VAULT_ACCESS_DENIED, NOT_FOUND, MISSING_PUBKEYS, MISSING_XPUB, INVALID_SIGNING_MODE, ...)

rules: Keys written in exactly the orders above; keys not listed are never serialized.
No whitespace anywhere. Strings and numbers use standard JSON.stringify encoding (all values here are ASCII). null/undefined/missing -> null.

members serialized in array order; canonicalJson does not sort. The server sorts members by wkIdentity ascending (plain JS string compare, a < b), and devices must REFUSE a descriptor whose members are not strictly ascending (sorted and unique).
descriptorHash = lowercase hex sha256 of the UTF-8 bytes of canonicalJson(descriptor).
orgId and vaultId are lowercase 24-hex Mongo ObjectId strings.

descriptorFieldRules.signingMode: Effective mode. UTXO/EVM vaults created in dual mode have NO signingMode stored; the descriptor normalizes absent -> 'dual'. Stored 'key_only'/'wallet_only'/'sol_dual'/'sol_single' are passed through. Solana always has sol_dual|sol_single.
descriptorFieldRules.xpubs: xpubWallet/xpubKey/walletXpubSignature/keyXpubSignature are exactly as stored by submitXpub; null only when absent (e.g. sol_single has no xpubKey/keyXpubSignature). key_only/wallet_only vaults still carry BOTH xpubs and attestations (submitXpub requires both for non-sol_single); only the xpubs the mode derives from are required to be non-null.
descriptorFieldRules.solanaXpubFormat: For Solana, xpubWallet/xpubKey are JSON strings of 20 base58 ed25519 pubkeys (leaf i = ed25519 seed = BIP32 secp256k1 private key at m/48'/slip'/orgIndex'/0'/vaultIndex/i; slip 501 solMainnet, 1 solDevnet).

notes: chain is the descriptor chain id (e.g. btc, flux, eth, solMainnet); orgIndex in decimal; xpub is the exact submitted string (Solana: the JSON array string).

Signature: Bitcoin signed message (bitcoinjs-message), base64 of the 65-byte compact signature with a compressed-key recovery header (31..34). Message prefix is ALWAYS "\x18Bitcoin Signed Message:\n" (server verifyBitcoinSignature default), whatever the vault chain.

Verify walletXpubSignature against the P2PKH address of member.walletPubKey and keyXpubSignature against the P2PKH address of member.keyPubKey. Network: testnet (version 0x6f) when wkIdentity starts with "tb1", else Bitcoin mainnet (version 0x00).
Signing keys: the WK identity keys, i.e. the BIP32 key at m/48'/0'/0'/2'/10/0 (btc identity chain) of the wallet seed and of the Key seed respectively.
The wallet/Key in production sign with extra entropy (non-deterministic); these vectors use RFC 6979 without extra entropy. Verification is the same.

wkIdentity.construction: witnessScript = OP_2 <pkA> <pkB> OP_2 OP_CHECKMULTISIG with {walletPubKey, keyPubKey} sorted ascending by lowercase hex (BIP67); wkIdentity = P2WSH (witness v0, sha256(witnessScript)) bech32 address.
wkIdentity.network: Bitcoin mainnet, hrp 'bc' (bc1q...). Testnet identities use hrp 'tb' (tb1q...); the server detects the network from the 'tb1' prefix.
wkIdentity.checks: walletPubKey !== keyPubKey; both 33-byte compressed (02/03) secp256k1 points.

derivation.typeIndex: The server uses descriptor.vaultIndex as the BIP48 'change' (typeIndex) level for EVERY vault address: path m/48'/slip'/orgIndex'/scriptType'/vaultIndex/addressIndex. There is NO separate change branch (typeIndex 1 is never used for vault addresses).
derivation.change: The UTXO builder (vaultTxBuilderService.getChangeAddress) spends only UTXOs of one source address (sourceAddressIndex, default 0) and sends change back to that same source address (typeIndex = vaultIndex, same addressIndex as the inputs), falling back to the vault's first stored address. So an output is change iff its scriptPubKey equals a derived vault address at (vaultIndex, i) for some i in 0..19.
derivation.utxo: Per member (descriptor order): wallet child key (unless key_only) then key child key (unless wallet_only), each = xpub/vaultIndex/addressIndex. All keys sorted ascending by hex (BIP67). m = 2*requiredSigners in dual, requiredSigners in key_only/wallet_only. p2wsh: witnessScript = multisig(m, keys), scriptPubKey = OP_0 sha256(ws). p2sh-p2wsh: redeemScript = P2WSH(ws), scriptPubKey = P2SH(hash160(redeemScript)). p2sh: redeemScript = multisig(m, keys), scriptPubKey = OP_HASH160 hash160(rs) OP_EQUAL. bch addresses are cashaddr.
derivation.evm: Same child keys in the same order (NOT sorted by the server) passed as aa-schnorr-multisig-sdk Key objects to SchnorrHelpers.getAllCombinedAddrFromKeysStrict(keys, m) (m = 2*requiredSigners dual, requiredSigners single-device), then create2Helpers.predictAccountImplementationAddrOffchain(factorySalt, factoryAddress, entrypointAddress) and predictAccountAddrOffchain(factoryAddress, impl, combinedAddresses, accountSalt). userOp.sender must equal this account at the proposal address index.
derivation.solana: For address index i: pubkeys = for each member (descriptor order) wallet[i] (+ key[i] in sol_dual); sorted by raw 32 bytes; threshold = 2*requiredSigners (sol_dual) or requiredSigners (sol_single); multisigPda = deriveMultisigAddress(sortedMembers, threshold, programId); vaultPda = deriveVaultAddress(multisigPda, descriptor.vaultIndex, programId) (@runonflux/solana-multisig). address = vaultPda.

vectors.name: btc-p2wsh-dual-2of3
vectors.description: Bitcoin P2WSH vault, dual mode (wallet + key per signer, 4-of-6 CHECKMULTISIG), 2-of-3 members. signingMode is NOT stored on the vault doc (as for every real dual vault); the descriptor normalizes it to "dual".

vectors.name: flux-p2sh-key_only-2of3
vectors.description: Flux P2SH vault, key_only mode (only the Key xpubs derive the 2-of-3 CHECKMULTISIG). The wallet xpubs/attestations are still submitted and appear in the descriptor as stored.

vectors.name: eth-evm-dual-1of2
vectors.description: Ethereum Schnorr multisig smart account, dual mode (2-of-4 Schnorr keys), 1-of-2 members. signingMode not stored (dual).

vectors.name: solMainnet-sol_dual-2of3
vectors.description: Solana mainnet vault, sol_dual mode (ed25519 threshold 4 over 6 members per address index), 2-of-3 members.

vectors.name: solMainnet-sol_single-2of2
vectors.description: Solana mainnet vault, sol_single mode (wallet pubkeys only): xpubKey and keyXpubSignature are null in the descriptor (null-handling vector).

negativeHashVectors.what: members reversed (unsorted: device must refuse on the sort check even though the hash matches this canonicalJson)
members[0].keyXpubSignature set to null (serialized as null)
